captions.instagram:
Sentabrda 6 ta o‘zbek startapi investitsiya oldi. Har bir raund $100 000 dan $200 000 gacha.

Bu katta pul emas. Lekin bu signal.

The Tech hisobotiga ko‘ra, sentabrda Markaziy Osiyoda pul olgan startaplarning ko‘pchiligi O‘zbekistondan. Eng faol investor IT Park Ventures: olti startapdan to‘rttasiga aynan u sarmoya kiritgan.

$100 000 bilan hamma narsani qurib bo‘lmaydi. Bu pul bitta narsani isbotlash uchun: mijoz pul to‘layaptimi, qaytib kelyaptimi, unit-ekonomika ishlayaptimi.

Bizning maslahat: pul tushgan kuniyoq keyingi raund uchun bitta asosiy ko‘rsatkichni tanlang va 6-9 oy ichida shuni ko‘rsating.

Startap qurayotgan do‘stingizga yuboring 👇
.

captions.linkedin:
$100K is not a runway. It's a test.

The Tech's September round-up of Central Asian startup deals is dominated by Uzbekistan: six Uzbek startups raised rounds between $100,000 and $200,000, and IT Park Ventures backed four of them. The mix is telling: AI platforms, a B2B marketplace, logistics and e-commerce infrastructure.

Two things stand out to us at AI Station.

First, pre-seed capital in Uzbekistan is flowing. The cheques are small, but this month alone they came from IT Park Ventures, UC Ventures, a private VC fund and the Digital Startups 1+1 programme.

Second, the size of the cheque sets the job. $100K buys roughly one clear proof point: paying customers, retention, or unit economics in one segment. Teams that spend it trying to build the whole roadmap tend to reach their next raise with a product and no evidence.

Our advice to founders who just closed: pick the one metric your next investor will ask about, and organise the next 6-9 months around moving it.

Founders and investors in the region: what is the one number you want to see before writing the follow-on cheque?

#Uzbekistan #CentralAsia #VentureCapital #Startups #AIStation
